purpose: Document primary local registry/custody evidence and bounded anonymous full-geometry discovery.
assessment: Official district land-record service and district cadastral-map georeferencing are confirmed. The public Bhunaksha shell loaded but opens a default Agra context; it does not verify Mau geometry. No parcel identifiers or full polygons were returned or retained.
registryAssessment: Official UP Bhulekh and district Mau sources establish revenue land-record and property-registration services for Mau district, including local tehsil/village cadastral-map georeferencing status. The data service is state-operated with district/tehsil selectors; this supports local service coverage but not anonymous polygon retrieval at the WUP settlement point.
